## Story
a0e4-18cf-36e9-4648 — As CI, I want the three calibration tracking tickets bootstrapped before the first calibration-rollup workflow run

## testing_mode: UPDATE

## What to do
Create `docs/calibration/README.md` (or extend it if it already exists) with a Setup section documenting the one-time bootstrap step. Operators who clone the repo fresh must know to run this before enabling calibration-rollup.yml.

Content to include:
```markdown
# Calibration Program Setup

## One-Time Bootstrap

Before enabling the calibration-rollup GitHub Actions workflow, run the bootstrap script to create the three calibration tracking tickets:

```bash
.claude/scripts/dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh
```

This script is idempotent — safe to run multiple times. It creates the following tracking tickets if they do not exist:
- `calibration-program-health` — monthly/quarterly health rollups
- `mutation-history` — per-CI-run mutation score accumulation
- `suite-churn-history` — per-CI-run suite churn accumulation

Once the tickets exist, the calibration-rollup workflow will run successfully. If the tickets are accidentally deleted, re-run the bootstrap script to recreate them.

## Preflight Integration (calibration-rollup.yml)

The calibration-rollup GHA workflow (implemented in story 9713-09ca) invokes this bootstrap script as a preflight step to ensure tracking tickets exist before attempting rollup operations.
```

## Verify
grep -l "dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets" docs/calibration/README.md
